findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Subscriptions.Rules.isPartnerDomain matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). No accepted authority: category/prefix check on "@partners.example.com" (line 11): no accepted record names "@partners.example.com". A category exemption lets one category bypass the rule; an exemption needs its own decision record, whatever the code comments call it. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
